KeyOfChild.kc1: A flashback showing your latchkey kid routine whenever you got home from school.
KeyOfChild.kc2: A flashback showing how you were an outsider among your school peers.
KeyOfChild.kc3: A flashback to the moment when you realized your parents were imperfect.
KeyOfChild.kc4: A flashback to when you felt genuine happiness as a child.
KeyOfChild.kc5: A flashback to when you experienced childhood trauma.
KeyOfChild.kc6: A flashback to the moment when you realized childhood wasn't forever.
KeyOfChild.kc7: A flashback to when you first discovered TV Odyssey.

DesolationKey.dk1Text: Unlock the End of Session question: “Did you receive a Signal from the Other Side?”
DesolationKey.dk2Text: Your Reason modifier is reduced by 1 and your Sensitivity modifier is increased by 1.
DesolationKey.dk3Text: You can now seek out the Big Man. How do you make contact with him? The Big Man can be consulted like any other Side Character. When you do so, roll with Sensitivity. On a 7-9, you gain 1 Clue; he will reveal it in a way that reflects his current disposition. On a 10+, as above, but you gain 2 Clues. On a miss, you must mark the next box on The Key of Desolation.
DesolationKey.dk4Text: You can no longer be perceived by other characters and all memory of you is erased—it's like you never existed. You can continue to conduct investigations, but the Clues you find are only available if you narrate them into an Odyssey tape scene.
DesolationKey.dk5Text: You lose contact with this world altogether. Tell the Keeper to play a white Odyssey tape and then retire this character.

Advancements.WriteMove: Write a custom Latchkey move for your character.
Advancements.ClearCorner: Unmark all the items in Your Corner of the House.

DawnQuestions.Hint: The first one is always marked. The second is always marked after it is unlocked. Mark two more.
DawnQuestions.dq1: Did the Latchkeys resolve a mystery?
DawnQuestions.dq2: Did you receive a Signal from the Other Side?
DawnQuestions.dq2Locked: (Locked until you mark The Sandstone Arch)
DawnQuestions.dq3: Did you share a good memory from your childhood?
DawnQuestions.dq5: Did you go out of your way to reconnect with Deep Lake?
DawnQuestions.dq6: Did you deliver a chilling monologue about something that happened to you in the past?
DawnQuestions.dq7: Did you cut loose for once?
